reviews.title: Excellent coverage and fast results—completely cleared out the pests!
reviews.body: If you are dealing with a stubborn bug problem, this 6-pack of Hot Shot Foggers is the ultimate solution. It is incredibly effective, easy to use, and provides the heavy-duty, multi-room coverage needed to handle a widespread infestation all at once.• Powerful Pest Elimination: It works incredibly fast to knock down a wide range of bugs, including roaches, ants, fleas, and spiders. It penetrates deep into cracks, crevices, and hiding spots that regular sprays completely miss.• Effective Odor Neutralizer: Unlike traditional bug bombs that leave a harsh, chemical stench lingering for days, this formula features a built-in odor neutralizer. It leaves the space smelling surprisingly clean and fresh once ventilated.• Massive Multi-Room Value: With 6 full-sized foggers in a single pack, it offers an incredibly economical way to treat an entire house, large basement, or detached garage simultaneously for total pest control.• Non-Staining Dry Mist: The fog releases as a fine, dry mist that settles uniformly without leaving sticky residues, oily stains, or messy puddles on your carpets, furniture, or hard flooring.• Simple and Reliable Operation: Setting them up is completely foolproof. The fine-mist actuators lock down cleanly with a single click, allowing you to safely activate the fogger and exit the area without any hassle.This is a professional-strength, highly reliable home treatment kit that saves you a fortune compared to hiring an exterminator. A must-have for fast and total peace of mind!

reviews.title: Good Bed Bug Bomb!
reviews.body: Had fleas really bad in some of the upstairs bedrooms. As soon as you walked in they started swarming you and eventually traveled throughout the house, honestly i have like a ptsd of things touching me now and im writing this incase it helps someone else.First i sprayed all thr rooms down with a indoor spray poison(home defense). Make sure you get all the corners and near baseboards aswell and if their in the bed you might wanna throw the mattress away or spray it down too atleast. Then i placed the foggers in the room overnight( or as long as possible) making sure all windows and doors are closed in each room. For larger rooms you might wanna put more than one fogger in there. That alone got rid of most of them. Almost completely out of the bedrooms. For the final act we added diatomaceous earth(you can get food grade if you have pets) in the common/open areas(kitchen, living room, dining room, etc.) .Honestly you can probably get rid of them with the diatomaceous earth alone (I didn’t find out about it until later) only thing is you’ll have to leave it down on the floor for a couple days. Also daily vaccuming/ mopping is also very important and helped ALOT.
